:::{#exm-ols-resid-orthogonal}
#### Residual sums in the `birthweight` model

For the `birthweight` model with an interaction term (`bw_lm2`),
we can compute $\tp{\mX}\vresid$,
$\sumin \resid_i$,
and $\sumin \hat y_i \resid_i$ directly:

```{r}
#| label: bw-resid-orthogonal
#| code-fold: show
bw_resid <- resid(bw_lm2)
crossprod(model.matrix(bw_lm2), bw_resid)
sum(bw_resid)
sum(fitted(bw_lm2) * bw_resid)
```

All three are zero up to floating-point rounding error,
as @thm-ols-resid-orthogonal guarantees.
Because the model includes an indicator for male babies,
the entry of $\tp{\mX}\vresid$ for that indicator is zero too:
the residuals for the male babies add up to zero,
and so, subtracting from the overall sum, do the residuals for the female babies.
:::
